messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Most students looked forward to the experience as a calm spell before graduation week, with all the family drama and stress of moving out of school, began.

output.original_text: Most students looked forward to the experience as a calm spell before graduation week, with all the family drama and stress of moving out of school, began.
output.joy: Most students eagerly anticipated the experience as a delightful calm before graduation week, before all the exciting family drama and the chaos of moving out of school began.
output.sadness: Most students heavily anticipated the experience as a bittersweet calm before graduation week, when all the family drama and the stressful reality of moving out of school would set in.
output.fear: Most students dreaded the experience, seeing it as an unsettling calm before graduation week, when all the family drama and the overwhelming stress of moving out of school loomed ahead.
output.anger: Most students felt frustrated with the experience, seeing it as a false calm before graduation week, before the inevitable family drama and exhausting stress of moving out of school hit them.
output.surprise: Most students found themselves unexpectedly looking forward to the experience as a surprising calm before graduation week, right before all the family drama and chaos of moving out of school erupted.
output.disgust: Most students looked forward to the experience with a sense of disdain, viewing it as a superficial calm before graduation week, when the ugly family drama and the stress of moving out of school reared its head.
